newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bangemann furious over question about his work.
newsitem.headline: Bangemann furious over question about his work.

text.p: Industrial Affairs Commissioner Martin Bangemann reacted angrily and walked of a news conference on Wednesday when asked by a German journalist whether he had been urged to be more active in his work at the Commission.

Bangemann, presenting a Commission report on the competitive strength of Europe's industry, was asked whether it was true that Commission President Jacques Santer had called on him to be more active and present within the Commission.
Bangemann refused to comment, describing the question as "rubbish."
"And if I answer it then I'll simply be giving you substance for writing even more rubbish," he said.

"I'm sorry ladies and gentlemen but we've been discussing the British problem (over the single currency) and others. This is a typical German problem. I apologise for that, have a nice day," Bangemann said before leaving the room.
